environment.installed_package_parity: 486/486/486/486 at installation; post-session payload exact with launcher-normalized installed outer descriptor

details: Archer Training Grounds, Barracks, Breweries, Mounted Training Fields, High Court And Revenue Offices, and Regional University Hospital rendered as differentiated simple silhouettes.
The transparent blocker-derived assets accepted CK3's native enabled-blue and unavailable/disabled gray presentation; no opaque painterly background remained.
The closed-session log contained zero AAWC DDS references and zero failed-to-load or failed-to-create texture diagnostics.
Pennon Hall ordinary slots exposed AAWC regular chains and did not expose any AAWC duchy chain.
Still Flats is the naturally inhabited tribal capital barony of the held High Lordship of Gleaming Plains and carries CK3's native duchy-capital slot.
The large special slot opened a panel titled 'Construct New Duchy Building' and exposed AAWC duchy chains including High Court And Revenue Offices and Regional University Hospital.
A regular slot in the same Still Flats holding opened 'Construct New Building' and exposed only ordinary AAWC chains, including Archer Training Grounds, Breweries, and Mounted Training Fields.
Representative ordinary construction menus at Pennon Hall and Still Flats contained AAWC replacement chains and no unbuilt vanilla or AGOT ordinary candidates.

The retained main-holding/ruin boundary remained present: the holding main line remained visible and the earlier direct ruin-panel inspection exposed the retained Reclaim Storm's End route rather than a suppressed ordinary legacy picker entry.
Existing retained and occupied entries remained inspectable, consistent with the save-compatibility policy.
Archer Training Grounds rendered unavailable with the explicit prerequisite 'Requires Barracks 1'.
Barracks 1 was constructed at Pennon Hall for 250 gold and completed on 3 Ninth Moon, 5 A.D.; CK3 displayed the completion notification.
After Barracks 1 completed, Archer Training Grounds became enabled in the replacement menu and CK3 accepted its 205-gold construction order (gold 766 to 561).
The duchy chains rendered their ordinary-foundation prerequisites in the special-slot panel, including High Court And Revenue Offices requiring Capital Bureau 3.
Representative regular and duchy entries rendered readable flavored descriptions without the removed proposal-only 'This tier provides' functional claim.
Effect panels rendered compact icon-and-value AAWC Structural Conditions and Settlement Space rows, plus exact Building Prerequisites text.
Workshops 8 rendered its mature flavor and compact +12 Opportunity, -3 Health, +1 Amenities, and -4% Settlement Space rows without visible localization failure.
The retained Storm's End ruin route rendered its Reclaim Storm's End presentation during the live review sequence.
Neighboring one-county tribal AI realms remained live during approximately three in-game years of the disposable observation session.
No reliable AI construction start or completion occurred in a reachable settled holding during the bounded observation window, and CK3 does not expose another ruler's construction candidate picker.
No AI menu selection or long-horizon build-priority certification is claimed; source policy tests remain the evidence that suppressed roots have no construction path and AAWC roots retain AI values.

runtime_events.initial_launch: The first 1.11.4.15 content-load attempt ended in Radeon allocation exhaustion while unrelated AGOT assets were loading; it emitted no AAWC DDS parse or texture-load error.
runtime_events.clean_retry: A clean retry reached the main menu and completed every observation recorded above.
runtime_events.exit: CK3 closed normally without exit autosave; no test save is retained in Git or the release archive.

fixture_policy.source: Disposable copies of the existing paused building-review fixture were edited outside the repository only to grant reachable title/capital combinations.
fixture_policy.canonical_special_slot: The accepted special-slot observation used naturally inhabited Still Flats, whose barony is already marked duchy_capital_barony and whose holding is already tribal; the rejected Hayford attempt remained wilderness and was not used as slot evidence.
fixture_policy.retention: All task-owned fixture saves are deleted after documentation and log audit.

remaining_limits: No long-horizon AI construction-priority certification is claimed.
Population-scaled economy/administration effects and military lifecycle effects remain intentionally deferred to their documented later stages.
